name: After recital A
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Moldova
part_text: Aa. whereas Moldova continues to face high levels of corruption, as reflected in Transparency International’s 2025 Corruption Perceptions Index, where it ranks 80th out of 182 countries; whereas Moldova’s economic fragility and persistent deficiencies in the rule of law, judicial independence and governance standards demonstrate that it does not fulfil the Copenhagen criteria for membership of the EU;
